objective: Candidate mechanically separates ceramic media from washers using a sieve; PR 1592 pours coins onto a table and sorts pennies and quarters into marked frames.
physical_skill: PR 1592 tests jar pouring, visual class discrimination, and planar pushing of individual coins. The candidate tests bimanual screen manipulation and passive geometry-based many-body separation through openings.
success_condition: PR 1592 awards 0.1 per correctly framed coin, with wrong or unplaced coins receiving no credit. The candidate awards recovery fraction subject to washer retention, valid aperture passage, no spill or damage, supported release, and dwell.
reason: Both separate mixed object classes, but the actual tested abilities differ: individual visual sorting versus physical size-selective screening.
